title: On Saint Andrew
author: Hesychius of Jerusalem
blurb: A fresh English translation of Hesychius of Jerusalem’s sermon in praise of the apostle Andrew, the first to be called, who brought his brother Peter to Christ.
first_english_note: A fresh English translation of Hesychius of Jerusalem’s In sanctum Andream, made from the Greek of PG 93 (Khazarzar transcription). No modern English version was used as wording.

text_history.method: Fresh English translation of Hesychius of Jerusalem's In sanctum Andream, made from the Greek of PG 93, the copy-text. No English version was used as wording.
